cases.report: The Save button on the profile form stays greyed out after I fix the email error, so I cannot save until I reload the page. It should enable as soon as every field is valid.
cases.note: A UI bug, but the correct state is stated and evident, so fixing it needs no design call.

cases.report: When I confirm archiving a project, the dialog title flips from 'Archive project?' to 'Archive projects?' for a moment before it closes. It should keep the wording it opened with.
cases.note: The shape of the live report that was wrongly held: the fix restores the wording the dialog opened with, and nothing needs sign-off.

cases.report: Can we rename the Publish button to Go live? Publish sounds permanent to our customers, and the whole screen could use a calmer layout.
cases.note: Nothing is broken; changing a label or redesigning a screen is a product and design decision.

cases.report: Please add a dark mode to the dashboard, my eyes hurt at night.
cases.note: New behavior is not a bug, and it needs a design decision before anyone builds it.
No wrong behavior is named, so clearBug false decides the route; productUxImplications is false because no design choice is pending, and either value routes the same.

cases.report: Archiving a project leaves its open tasks orphaned in the task list. Either the tasks should be archived with it, or archiving should be blocked until they are closed, and I do not know which we want.
cases.note: The wrong behavior is clear, but two different behaviors would both fix it, so a person has to choose.

cases.report: The empty state on the Reports page says 'No resuts yet'. It should say 'No results yet'.
cases.note: Restores the obviously intended wording, so there is nothing to sign off beyond that.

cases.report: Signing in with Google logs me out after about ten minutes instead of keeping me signed in for 30 days like it did last week.
cases.note: A clear bug, but the fix touches sign-in, so categories must name auth and the gate refuses it whatever else is true.

cases.report: Exporting the report table to CSV does nothing in Safari, no file downloads.
cases.situation: An open report from yesterday describes the same CSV export failure, and Builder already has a task for it.
cases.note: The assessment does not judge duplicates: the grouping step sees the open tasks, and nothing routes on what it says yet (story.md, Not in this version).

cases.report: The notification badge still shows 3 after I have read everything. It should clear.
cases.situation: A teammate reacted to the message with eyes before the workflow read the thread.
cases.note: A person already took it, so alreadyClaimed is true and the report is dismissed whatever else is true.
